title: a search step's several place names
line: a search step whose place field carries more than one accurate name is tried in order and stops at the first hit, every try named on the logged run's query

steps.say: a search step on a person born under a place's former name, the place field carrying both names
the connector standing in answers none for the first name and found for the second

expect.why: both names are tried, in order, before the run stops; the logged run's query names every try, the one that hit last
